description: Read nudges observed from the active real CLI copilot stream. Use cursor (or a numeric since value) for lossless delta reads; since also accepts durations such as '5m'/'30s' and ISO timestamps. MCP never generates nudges itself. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-read_copilot_nudges

cursor.description: Return nudge lines after this zero-based observation cursor.

since.description: Cursor string, duration such as '5m' or '30s', or ISO timestamp. Do not combine with cursor.

name: read_copilot_nudges
